note: Scenario-to-production-test/assertion mapping for all 43 Increment 021 Checkpoint 1 scenarios (SCENARIOS_021.csv rows T021-001-040 and T021-159-161). One pytest item per scenario id - no parametrization inflation (43 scenarios -> 43 collected items). Every test calls real production functions/classes from src/molecular/receptor_materialization.py with explicit oracles; no algorithm is copied into the test to produce its own expected value.

scenarios.assertion: int/bytes rejected for a str field with no coercion
scenarios.limit: pydantic ValidationError, not a custom domain error

scenarios.assertion: bool rejected for int field; int rejected for bool field
scenarios.limit: strict=True is required module-wide; lax pydantic v2 would accept both

scenarios.assertion: extra field rejected; post-construction mutation rejected (frozen)
scenarios.limit: covers one representative DTO, not all - frozen/extra=forbid/strict is applied identically to every class in the module

scenarios.assertion: non-str datetime rejected; impossible calendar date (Feb 30) rejected; non-canonical shape rejected; canonical form accepted
scenarios.limit: pure string-shape/calendar validation only

scenarios.production_target: Engine Literal + ReceptorInspectionReport Literal + build_source_context ENGINE_VERSION check
scenarios.assertion: engine name/version divergence rejected at both the DTO Literal boundary and the build_source_context cross-check; inspection schema version divergence rejected at the reused 020 Literal boundary
scenarios.limit: catalogue_sha256/profile/algorithm are planner-side constants (CATALOGUE_SHA256, '1.0') never read from caller input in CP1, so their own-divergence path is proven only via the Literal-typed PlanBinding/SourceContext fields, not a runtime 'wrong catalogue' call

scenarios.assertion: mismatched selection_id and mismatched raw_checksum across the three in-memory records both raise MaterializationConfigurationError, never a silent inspect/resolve fallback
scenarios.limit: no file I/O performed; the four 'captured records' are already in-memory 020 objects supplied by the caller

scenarios.assertion: a tampered inspection_id that does not reproduce from its own 7-field payload is rejected
scenarios.limit: reuses receptor_inspection.compute_inspection_id verbatim, per the brief's explicit instruction

scenarios.assertion: selection_capability != 'full' rejected; a 'full' report that still carries a parser-limitation warning is also rejected
scenarios.limit: checks exactly the two conditions named in the scenario; does not re-validate every other inspection warning code

scenarios.assertion: resolved_model=5 (not the lowest/first model present) is the one actually used to partition atoms
scenarios.limit: model selection itself is a 020 concern (resolved_model); this proves the planner consumes it verbatim

scenarios.assertion: a non-null resolved_assembly is rejected (UNSUPPORTED_REQUEST) before any plan is built
scenarios.limit: no assembly operator is ever read or applied - this is a closed-scope refusal, not a partial implementation

scenarios.assertion: empty resolved_chains is rejected (EMPTY_SELECTION) rather than silently treated as select-everything
scenarios.limit: 020's own ResolvedReceptorSelection model structurally permits an empty tuple; the refusal is this module's own added rule

scenarios.assertion: an atom is retained by matching its label_asym_id against S even when auth_asym_id differs by case
scenarios.limit: demonstrates the identity used for S-membership, not every place auth_asym_id appears (e.g. author_id_coincidence, covered by T021-037, intentionally also keys off auth, never label)

scenarios.assertion: two distinct raw auth_asym_id tokens that normalize to the same NFC form are rejected, never silently merged
scenarios.limit: the injective-index guard is exercised through the polymer auth-id correspondence table specifically; it is a general-purpose helper but only this one call site is proven here

scenarios.assertion: a polymer asym absent from S and with no disposition becomes exactly one XEntry with reason chain-complement on its atoms
scenarios.limit: single-asym case; uniformity across multiple complement asyms is implied, not separately re-asserted

scenarios.assertion: polymer-in-S-with-remove-disposition and polymer-outside-S-with-keep-disposition both raise SELECTION_CONFLICT
scenarios.limit: two independent sub-cases in one test function, each with its own fresh resolution/source_context

scenarios.assertion: two CCD variants of the same non-polymer asym resolving to different keep/remove decisions raise NONUNIFORM_ASYM
scenarios.limit: no struct_conn/connection awareness is modeled in CP1 - the refusal is purely from the disposition table, as the frozen spec allows for this checkpoint

scenarios.assertion: same construction as T021-016, asserting specifically code=='NONUNIFORM_ASYM' (never a silent partial split of the branched asym)
scenarios.limit: same limit as T021-016

scenarios.assertion: two atom rows of the same occurrence (simulating altloc/H-D variants) both receive the identical retained/reason outcome
scenarios.limit: AtomObservation carries no altloc/occupancy field at all in CP1 - uniformity is structural (decided per occurrence, never per atom), not computed from an altloc value

scenarios.assertion: an atom in a different model (2, while M=1) is excluded with reason=model-filter regardless of any disposition that might otherwise apply
scenarios.limit: proves the model boundary, not a full multi-model struct_conn scenario (CP2)

scenarios.assertion: unaddressed_components='preserve' includes an unaddressed non-polymer asym (reason=unaddressed-preserve); 'require-disposition' rejects it (SELECTION_CONFLICT); the same asym included via explicit S instead uses reason=selected-asym
scenarios.limit: three sub-cases in one function

scenarios.assertion: preview succeeds with a non-empty X and no acknowledgement at all; declare without acknowledge_exclusions_key raises MISSING_ACK
scenarios.limit: n/a

scenarios.assertion: a wrong (stale/incorrect) acknowledge_exclusions_key raises ACK_MISMATCH
scenarios.limit: n/a

scenarios.assertion: a non-null acknowledge_exclusions_key is rejected when X is empty, even if it is the correct canonical empty-vector hash
scenarios.limit: n/a

scenarios.assertion: a 2-atom polymer chain outside S is excluded wholly (atom_count=2, one XEntry); acknowledging the exact exclusions_key converts it into a recorded excluded_polymer_asym_count=1
scenarios.limit: the chemistry (nucleic vs protein) is not distinguished by this module at all - entity_type is 'polymer' either way, consistent with the frozen spec's complement rule applying uniformly; hydrog-omission-to-the-retained-strand (also named in T021-024's CSV text) is CP2 struct_conn territory and is explicitly out of this test's scope

scenarios.assertion: declare without acknowledge_outside_key raises MISSING_ACK when O is non-empty
scenarios.limit: n/a

scenarios.assertion: a wrong acknowledge_outside_key raises ACK_MISMATCH
scenarios.limit: n/a

scenarios.assertion: a non-null acknowledge_outside_key is rejected when O is empty
scenarios.limit: n/a

scenarios.assertion: changing only the underlying atom_id of an O occurrence (same visible label_asym_id/ccd/auth_seq) changes outside_key, and the old outside_key is then rejected by declare (ACK_MISMATCH)
scenarios.limit: n/a

scenarios.assertion: blank/whitespace-only and C0-control-containing declared_by rejected; a real Unicode name is preserved byte-for-byte, uncoerced
scenarios.limit: n/a

scenarios.assertion: repeating the identical declaration against an already-built in-memory PolicyRecord returns the same policy_id and the original declared_at, not the newly supplied one
scenarios.limit: proves the pure equivalence/identity rule only; no persisted registry/create-once guarantee is claimed (that is Checkpoint 3's storage layer)

scenarios.assertion: the identical vector hashed under two different 'kind' envelope strings yields two different digests
scenarios.limit: n/a

scenarios.assertion: object key order never changes the hash; list element order always does
scenarios.limit: n/a

scenarios.assertion: an ordinary finite float, and NaN, are both rejected before hashing - not merely NaN/Infinity as plain json.dumps(allow_nan=False) alone would reject
scenarios.limit: n/a

scenarios.assertion: changing declared_by or acknowledge_exclusions_key changes policy_id; compute_policy_id's own signature carries no declared_at parameter at all
scenarios.limit: n/a

scenarios.assertion: changing application_version changes request_key; changing policy_file_sha256 also changes it
scenarios.limit: n/a

scenarios.assertion: two water occurrences with label_seq_id=null distinguished solely by auth_seq_id hash to different occurrence_keys; an occurrence with both label_seq_id and auth_seq_id null is rejected
scenarios.limit: n/a

scenarios.assertion: all five AuthorIdCoincidence values are exercised against a single plan: retained-polymer, excluded-polymer, none, unavailable, and multiple (two polymer asyms sharing one auth id)
scenarios.limit: n/a - all five closed-vocabulary values proven in one scenario

scenarios.assertion: PlanBinding structurally carries no acknowledge_* or commit_state field at all (so preview cannot even represent a pre-filled consent); declare without the required X acknowledgement still raises MISSING_ACK
scenarios.limit: n/a

scenarios.assertion: entity_type='unknown' in M raises MaterializationInputError(code='UNSUPPORTED_REQUEST'), never classified by a HETATM-style heuristic
scenarios.limit: n/a

scenarios.assertion: no 'import gemmi'/'from gemmi'/'import rdkit'/'from rdkit' statement and no open()/Path() call anywhere in the module's own source text
scenarios.limit: a static source-text check, not a runtime import-hook/sandbox proof

scenarios.assertion: application_version is not even a field of PlanBinding or PolicyRecord (so it structurally cannot affect plan_key/policy_id); changing it alone still changes request_key
scenarios.limit: n/a

scenarios.assertion: changing one atom's id (a decision-vector-level change) changes plan_key; declaring the new plan against the old plan_key as acknowledge_plan_key raises ACK_MISMATCH
scenarios.limit: CP1 has no catalogue/engine/profile *runtime* variation point (those are fixed constants in this checkpoint - see T021-005's limit), so the 'changed decisions' side of this scenario is proven via the atom-decision vector, the one decision family CP1 actually computes

scenarios.assertion: action='omit' with every tag array empty constructs successfully (no textual 'all' sentinel is required or checked); action='guard_then_omit' with an empty omitted_tags is rejected, requiring its guarded tags enumerated first
scenarios.limit: CategoryDecision is exercised at the DTO/validation level only in CP1 - no real catalogue row filtering exists yet (that is Checkpoint 2, Section 11 of the frozen spec)
